import json, urllib.request, urllib.error; BASE='http://127.0.0.1:8080'; HOST='Bearer vanta-local-dev-token'; ATLAS='Bearer vanta-local-collaborator-token';

def req(path, method='GET', token=None, body=None):
    headers={}
    if token: headers['Authorization']=token
    data=None
    if body is not None:
        data=json.dumps(body).encode(); headers['Content-Type']='application/json'
    request=urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=data, headers=headers, method=method)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as resp:
            raw=resp.read().decode(); return resp.status, json.loads(raw) if raw else None
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        raw=exc.read().decode(); return exc.code, json.loads(raw) if raw else None

report=req('/api/v1/live/streams/lv-deepsaint-live/report','POST',ATLAS,{'reason':'spam','details':'notify creator'})
assert report[0] == 202, report
creator_notes=req('/api/v1/creator/me/notifications','GET',HOST)
assert creator_notes[0] == 200 and any(item['kind'] == 'live_report_received' for item in creator_notes[1]), creator_notes
creator_note_id=next(item['id'] for item in creator_notes[1] if item['kind'] == 'live_report_received')
read_creator=req(f'/api/v1/creator/me/notifications/{creator_note_id}/read','POST',HOST)
assert read_creator[0] == 204, read_creator
session=req('/api/v1/creator/me/live/collabs/sessions','POST',HOST,{'broadcastId':'bcast-now','title':'notif flow','chatMode':'shared','recordingPolicy':'host_archive'})
assert session[0] == 200, session
sid=session[1]['id']
invite=req(f'/api/v1/creator/me/live/collabs/sessions/{sid}/invites','POST',HOST,{'inviteeUserId':'usr-2','role':'guest','mirrorToGuestChannel':False,'message':'notif invite','expiresInMinutes':30})
assert invite[0] == 200, invite
user_notes=req('/api/v1/me/notifications','GET',ATLAS)
assert user_notes[0] == 200 and any(item['kind'] == 'collaboration_invite' for item in user_notes[1]), user_notes
invite_note_id=next(item['id'] for item in user_notes[1] if item['kind'] == 'collaboration_invite')
read_user=req(f'/api/v1/me/notifications/{invite_note_id}/read','POST',ATLAS)
assert read_user[0] == 204, read_user
